content: Sometimes the training dataset may not be enough to learn optimal policy for all INLINEFORM0 . Thus, encountering an unseen state during test can make RL-model clueless about the action. Given a state INLINEFORM1 , whenever an invalid INLINEFORM2 is chosen, LiLi remains in INLINEFORM3 . For INLINEFORM4 , LiLi remains in INLINEFORM5 untill INLINEFORM6 (see Table 1 for INLINEFORM7 ). So, if the state remains the same for ( INLINEFORM8 +1) times, it implies LiLi has encountered a fault (an unseen state). RL-model instantly switches to the training mode and randomly explores INLINEFORM9 to learn the optimal action (fault-tolerant learning). While exploring INLINEFORM10 , the model chooses INLINEFORM11 only when it has tried all other INLINEFORM12 to avoid abrupt end of episode.
